blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: recursive — Process invoking itself on children.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Post-order visits both child subtrees before its parent. Traverse left subtree, right subtree, then root.

blocks.title: Model
blocks.text: Breadth-first visits by levels, left-to-right with a queue that stores the next vertices.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Traversal result depends on the precise tree and stated child order. BFS queue changes must be shown to justify an answer.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain
blocks.text: PostOrder(5) waits for PostOrder(2), which prints 1 then 2. The right call prints 7; only then is 5 printed: 1,2,7,5. null returns without printing. Node supplies Key, Left and Right.
